subject.title: fix(ai): preserve compat xhigh reasoning effort

question: Should OpenClaw formally support `supportedReasoningEfforts` and `reasoningEffortMap` as public model-configuration controls for both OpenAI-compatible Completions and Responses providers?
rationale: The patch expands accepted provider-compatibility configuration and changes outbound request behavior; tests can verify mechanics, but they cannot choose the durable public contract or its documentation and support boundary.

options.title: Accept the unified compatibility contract
options.body: Approve the metadata as the canonical cross-transport provider contract, then require current-head redacted live-request proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep the fix scoped to the already-approved transport or configuration surface and defer the remaining schema fields until their API shape is agreed.

options.title: Pause for owner design
options.body: Hold both overlapping PRs until an owner defines the long-term model compatibility API and documentation boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept the unified compatibility contract
recommendation.body: Approve the metadata as the canonical cross-transport provider contract, then require current-head redacted live-request proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Alex-Govorov authored the underlying compatibility design and regression coverage carried by both related branches.
